ax-2401.14109.authors: Andrei Tomut, Saeed S. Jahromi, Abhijoy Sarkar et al. (Multiverse Computing; incl. Samuel Mugel, Roman Orus)

links.label: Science News — A quantum trick helps trim bloated AI models (Dec 2025)
MIT Technology Review — DeepSeek R1 Slim (Nov 2025)
The Quantum Insider — Series C up to $570M (Jul 2026)
The New Stack — Quasar 438B, benchmarks questioned (Sep 2026)
Science News — tensor networks and AI startups (Jan 2026)

ax-2401.14109.splashWhy: The paper predates the window (January 2024); the splash came after it, as the method behind Multiverse Computing's compressed-model business: a €189M (about $215M) Series B in June 2025, DeepSeek R1 Slim covered by MIT Technology Review in November 2025, open-weight HyperNova 60B in February 2026, a Series C targeting up to $570M in July 2026 and Quasar 438B in September 2026. Figures are company-reported; The New Stack questioned the Quasar benchmarks.
ax-2401.14109.summary: Compresses LLM weights with quantum-inspired tensor networks combined with quantisation, reporting about 93% memory and 70% parameter reduction on LLaMA-7B for a 2–3% accuracy loss; published at ESANN 2025.
ax-2401.14109.title: CompactifAI: Extreme Compression of Large Language Models using Quantum-Inspired Tensor Networks

ax-2410.02117.authors: Andres Potapczynski, Shikai Qiu, Marc Finzi, Christopher Ferri, Zixi Chen, Micah Goldblum, Bayan Bruss, Christopher De Sa, Andrew Gordon Wilson
ax-2410.02117.summary: Unifies Einsum-expressible linear layers (low-rank, Kronecker, Tensor-Train, Block Tensor-Train, Monarch), studies compute-optimal scaling and proposes BTT-MoE with reported compute-efficiency gains over dense layers and standard MoE.
ax-2410.02117.title: Searching for Efficient Linear Layers over a Continuous Space of Structured Matrices

ax-2410.08417.authors: Michael T. Pearce, Thomas Dooms, Alice Rigg, Jose M. Oramas, Lee Sharkey
ax-2410.08417.edge: a single third-order tensor, not a multi-core tensor network
ax-2410.08417.summary: Shows that bilinear MLPs (gated units without element-wise nonlinearity) can be written with a third-order tensor whose eigendecomposition reveals low-rank structure on toy tasks, image classification and language models, enabling weight-only circuit discovery, adversarial examples and overfitting diagnosis (tensor-structured rather than an explicit multi-core tensor network, so borderline for strict TN scope).
ax-2410.08417.title: Bilinear MLPs enable weight-based mechanistic interpretability

ax-2410.17397.authors: Borja Aizpurua, Fernando Loren, Saeed S. Jahromi, Sukhbinder Singh, Roman Orus
ax-2410.17397.summary: Replaces the self-attention and MLP weight matrices of a pretrained LLM with two variational quantum circuits coupled to an MPO, using tensor-network disentanglers so the classical remainder compresses to a bond-dimension-one MPO (classical parameters of the replaced layer fall from 110,592 to about 36 with under 0.3% perplexity increase), and a trained unitary adapter then lowers perplexity by up to 1.6%; validated on a real quantum processor.
ax-2410.17397.title: Quantum Large Language Models via Tensor Network Disentanglers

ax-2410.23858.summary: Writes a neural-network potential energy surface directly in matrix-product-operator form so high-dimensional Schrodinger-equation integrals are cheap to evaluate, reaching 3.03 cm^-1 test MAE on a fully coupled six-dimensional ab initio surface from 625 training points.
ax-2410.23858.title: Neural Network Matrix Product Operator: A Multi-Dimensionally Integrable Machine Learning Potential

ax-2412.05674.authors: Jing-Chuan Wu, Qi Ye, Dong-Ling Deng, Li-Wei Yu
ax-2412.05674.summary: Proves no-free-lunch theorems for tensor-network ML models for MPS (1D) and PEPS (2D, via a polyomino-puzzle combinatorial argument that avoids computing the 2D Ising partition function), exposing intrinsic generalisation limits.
ax-2412.05674.title: No-Free-Lunch Theories for Tensor-Network Machine Learning Models

ax-2412.15826.authors: Joshua B. Moore, Hugo P. Stackhouse, Ben D. Fulcher, Sahand Mahmoodian
ax-2412.15826.summary: MPSTime learns the joint distribution of a time-series dataset with an MPS (maximum bond dimension about 20-160) and handles classification and imputation under one log-loss, performing competitively with state-of-the-art ML on medical, energy and astronomy datasets while exposing interpretable structure, with code released.
ax-2412.15826.title: Using matrix-product states for time-series machine learning

ax-2412.20891.authors: Xiaolin Hu, Xiang Cheng, Peiyu Liu, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Bin Wang, Yong Liu
ax-2412.20891.summary: Initialises a tensor adapter from an MPO decomposition of the pretrained weights (default 5 cores, bond dimension 16) instead of random initialisation, with a 4-bit variant QDoTA; on LLaMA2-7B it averages 81.6% on commonsense reasoning with 0.15% trainable parameters versus 77.6% for LoRA at 0.83% and 81.2% for full fine-tuning.
ax-2412.20891.title: DoTA: Weight-Decomposed Tensor Adaptation for Large Language Models

ax-2501.06300.authors: José Ramón Pareja Monturiol, Alejandro Pozas-Kerstjens, David Pérez-García
ax-2501.06300.summary: TT-RSS builds a tensor-train (MPS) representation of a black-box function from sketching and cross-interpolation using only function queries and a small set of sample points, and uses it to obfuscate trained neural networks, make them easier to interpret, and compress them with a better memory-time trade-off than standard tensorization.
ax-2501.06300.title: Tensorization of neural networks for improved privacy and interpretability
ax-2501.06300.venue: SciPost Physics Core 8(4), 095; also poster at the NeurIPS 2025 ML and the Physical Sciences workshop

ax-2501.06425.authors: Yifan Zhang, Yifeng Liu, Huizhuo Yuan, Zhen Qin, Yang Yuan, Quanquan Gu, Andrew Chi-Chih Yao
ax-2501.06425.edge: a CP-style tensor factorisation of attention activations rather than a tensor network
ax-2501.06425.summary: Factorises queries, keys and values into contextual sums of tensor (outer) products, which shrinks the KV cache at inference and works with rotary position embeddings; the T6 Transformer built on it matches or beats MHA, MQA, GQA and MLA on the paper's language-modelling metrics.
ax-2501.06425.title: Tensor Product Attention Is All You Need

ax-2501.06663.authors: Jiayi Tian, Jinming Lu, Hai Li, Xiangwei Wang, Cong Hao, Ian Young, Zheng Zhang
ax-2501.06663.summary: End-to-end on-FPGA transformer training with tensor-train weights (TT) and TTM embeddings using a bi-directional contraction flow and all parameters and gradients kept on-chip, giving 30-51x lower memory than uncompressed GPU training on ATIS (e.g. a 6-block model shrinks from 93.5 MB to 1.8 MB).
ax-2501.06663.title: Ultra Memory-Efficient On-FPGA Training of Transformers via Tensor-Compressed Optimization

ax-2501.18691.summary: Proposes a regularised modified Newton method on the manifold of normalised states for training TN Born machines, improving convergence and stability over iterative single-tensor updates when fitting a 1D MPS to discrete and continuous datasets.
ax-2501.18691.title: Regularized second-order optimization of tensor-network Born machines

ax-2501.18856.authors: Shota Sugawara, Kazuki Inomata, Tsuyoshi Okubo, Synge Todo
ax-2501.18856.summary: Embeds optimised tree tensor networks into shallow quantum circuits as initial states for variational algorithms to mitigate barren plateaus, reporting better initial circuits than MPS embeddings at practical computational cost.
ax-2501.18856.title: Embedding of Tree Tensor Networks into Shallow Quantum Circuits

ax-2501.19135.authors: Sixiao Huang, Tintin Wang, Ang Li, Ao Shen, Kai Li, Keyao Jiang, Mingqiang Huang, Hao Yu
ax-2501.19135.summary: Compresses LLM linear layers with tensor-train decomposition and runs them on an FPGA group vector systolic array, giving whole-network compression of 1.94x (ChatGLM3-6B) and 1.60x (LLaMA2-7B) and first-token delay reductions of 1.45x and 1.57x.
ax-2501.19135.title: A Tensor-Train Decomposition based Compression of LLMs on Group Vector Systolic Accelerator

ax-2502.09928.summary: DTTN stacks antisymmetric interaction modules in a tree-shaped tensor network with parameter sharing to capture 2^L-order multiplicative feature interactions, argues quantum-inspired tensor-network models are equivalent to polynomial or multilinear networks under certain conditions, and reports better performance than peer methods and state-of-the-art architectures on several image benchmarks.
ax-2502.09928.title: Deep Tree Tensor Networks

ax-2502.13090.authors: Ema Puljak, Sergio Sanchez-Ramirez, Sergi Masot-Llima, Jofre Vallès-Muns, Artur Garcia-Saez, Maurizio Pierini
ax-2502.13090.summary: Library for building tensor-network models into ML optimisation pipelines, with modules for data embedding, objective functions and training strategies, demonstrated on supervised learning with tabular data and unsupervised learning on an image dataset.
ax-2502.13090.title: tn4ml: Tensor Network Training and Customization for Machine Learning
ax-2502.13090.venue: arXiv preprint (library github.com/bsc-quantic/tn4ml, 24 stars when checked)

ax-2502.16464.summary: Uses MPS to build shallow-circuit approximate amplitude encodings of functions (accuracy above 99.99% for low-degree piecewise polynomials) and images, preparing a 128x128 ChestMNIST image on 14 qubits with fidelity above 99.2% at circuit depth 425.
ax-2502.16464.title: Quantum Encoding of Structured Data with Matrix Product States

ax-2503.05431.authors: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Francesco Tonin, Yongtao Wu, Frank Zhengqing Wu, Leyla Naz Candogan, Volkan Cevher
ax-2503.05431.edge: the tensor-network module is secondary to Pauli-rotation adapters
ax-2503.05431.summary: Parameterises full-rank adapter updates as quantum unitaries via generalized Pauli rotations (with a quantum tensor-network module as a secondary contribution, so TN content is borderline), making trainable parameters grow logarithmically with dimension and claiming a 5-25x reduction versus LoRA with competitive results on language and vision transfer benchmarks.
ax-2503.05431.title: Quantum-PEFT: Ultra parameter-efficient fine-tuning

ax-2503.10483.summary: Uses MPS classifiers on a 1D qubit lattice (Fashion-MNIST and hepatocellular-carcinoma gene expression) to argue that grokking coincides with an entanglement dynamical transition, and uses MPS magnetisation and correlation functions to identify gene subcommunities validated by enrichment analysis.
ax-2503.10483.title: Grokking as an entanglement transition in tensor network machine learning

ax-2503.12790.authors: Xiaofei Kong, Lei Li, Zhaoyun Chen, Cheng Xue, Xiaofan Xu, Huanyu Liu, Yuchun Wu, Yuan Fang, Han Fang, Kejiang Chen, Yang Yang, Menghan Dou, Guoping Guo
ax-2503.12790.summary: Quantum Tensor Hybrid Adaptation (QTHA) decomposes pretrained weights into an MPO plus a quantum neural network; against rank-4 LoRA it uses about 76% fewer trainable parameters (0.30M vs 1.26M) with lower training loss on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and Qwen2-7B-Instruct, though test sets are small (30-100 samples).
ax-2503.12790.title: Quantum-Enhanced LLM Efficient Fine Tuning

ax-2504.02667.authors: Thomas Dooms, Ward Gauderis, Geraint A. Wiggins, Jose Oramas
ax-2504.02667.summary: Proposes chi-nets, intrinsically interpretable architectures that combine the multilinear structure of tensor networks with deep-network performance and match their baselines in accuracy, and introduces ODT, a diagonalisation algorithm that exposes low-rank linear structure in a multilayer SVHN model for weight-based interpretability and compression.
ax-2504.02667.title: Compositionality Unlocks Deep Interpretable Models

ax-2504.06474.authors: Jinming Lu, Jiayi Tian, Hai Li, Ian Young, Zheng Zhang
ax-2504.06474.summary: Co-designs a contraction-sequence search engine with a reconfigurable array of contraction engines for training tensorized networks, reporting 20.5x/100.9x lower latency and 567.5x/45.0x lower energy than GPU/TPU, and 3.87-14.63x speedup over prior tensorized-training accelerators.
ax-2504.06474.title: FETTA: Flexible and Efficient Hardware Accelerator for Tensorized Neural Network Training
ax-2504.06474.venue: arXiv preprint (v2 Mar 2026; DOI indicates IEEE TCAD)

ax-2504.06722.authors: Katsuya O. Akamatsu, Kenji Harada, Tsuyoshi Okubo, Naoki Kawashima
ax-2504.06722.summary: Proposes a structural-optimisation scheme for a single-layer nonnegative adaptive tensor tree that learns the network topology from data (bitwise operations, random Bayesian networks, a mitochondrial-DNA cladogram), performing comparably to Born-machine adaptive tensor trees on negative log-likelihood while yielding interpretable structure.
ax-2504.06722.title: Plastic tensor networks for interpretable generative modeling

ax-2504.09250.summary: Converts pre-trained MPS classifiers into quantum MPS circuits by starting from a postselected circuit and gradually removing the postselection, arguing this sidesteps the exponentially hard barren-plateau training of such circuits from scratch on a specific artificial dataset, with numerical experiments on binary MNIST.
ax-2504.09250.title: Adiabatic Encoding of Pre-trained MPS Classifiers into Quantum Circuits

ax-2504.14995.summary: Introduces forest tensor network classifiers, ensembles of small-bond-dimension tree tensor networks that avoid high-order gates, and adiabatically encodes them into quantum forest classifiers without postselection overhead, with MNIST and CIFAR-10 experiments showing performance is maintained or improved.
ax-2504.14995.title: Trainable Quantum Neural Network for Multiclass Image Classification with the Power of Pre-trained Tree Tensor Networks

ax-2504.21190.authors: Pradip Kunwar, Minh N. Vu, Maanak Gupta, Mahmoud Abdelsalam, Manish Bhattarai
ax-2504.21190.summary: Trains frozen per-task tensor-train LoRA experts independently and adds a separately trained router that picks one expert per input, using about 2% of LoRA's parameters, 0.3% of Adapters' and 0.03% of AdapterFusion's while outperforming AdapterFusion in multi-task settings.
ax-2504.21190.title: TT-LoRA MoE: Unifying Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning and Sparse Mixture-of-Experts

ax-2505.03399.authors: Florian J. Kiwit, Bernhard Jobst, Andre Luckow, Frank Pollmann, Carlos A. Riofrío
ax-2505.03399.summary: Presents an algorithm that finds low-depth circuits loading MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Imagenette images, releases the circuits as PennyLane datasets, and compares quantum classifiers including tensor-network classifiers against convolutional neural networks.
ax-2505.03399.title: Typical Machine Learning Datasets as Low-Depth Quantum Circuits

ax-2505.03911.authors: Hans Hohenfeld, Marius Beuerle, Elie Mounzer
ax-2505.03911.summary: Extends MPS-based explainable anomaly detection from discrete to real-valued data and adds tree tensor networks, showing adequate predictive performance against baselines on three benchmarks while being able to explain anomalous samples.
ax-2505.03911.title: Explaining Anomalies with Tensor Networks
ax-2505.03911.venue: DOI 10.1109/QAI63978.2025.00033 (IEEE; prefix suggests QAI 2025); v2 September 2025

ax-2505.06419.authors: Xun Tang, Yuehaw Khoo, Lexing Ying
ax-2505.06419.summary: Shows MPS Born machines trained by gradient descent from random initialisation fall into a 'causality trap' that ignores non-local correlations, and fixes it with natural-gradient descent (global minimum 'in only a few iterations' with line search) plus a TTNS-Sketch warm start.
ax-2505.06419.title: Initialization and training of matrix product state probabilistic models

ax-2505.09371.summary: Warm-starts RL-based quantum architecture search with an MPS approximation of the target solution, reporting on chemistry problems up to 12 qubits up to 10x fewer CNOTs and depth, up to 100x fewer optimizer evaluations, up to 98% faster training episodes, and 50% success on 10 qubits versus under 1% for the baseline.
ax-2505.09371.title: TensorRL-QAS: Reinforcement learning with tensor networks for improved quantum architecture search

ax-2505.14871.authors: Ryan Solgi, Kai Zhen, Rupak Vignesh Swaminathan, Nathan Susanj, Athanasios Mouchtaris, Siegfried Kunzmann, Zheng Zhang
ax-2505.14871.summary: Adds a sparse component to tensor-train-compressed LLM weights and recovers accuracy by fine-tuning; on LLaMA-3.2-1B it shrinks 1.24B to 0.38B parameters (about 4x fewer MACs) while matching base BoolQ accuracy (67.0 vs 66.5), beating plain TT and SVD at comparable sizes though other SuperGLUE tasks drop, and roughly halves BERT-Base (109.5M to 50.3M).
ax-2505.14871.title: Saten: Sparse Augmented Tensor Networks for Post-Training Compression of Large Language Models

ax-2505.17740.summary: Uses a tensor-network model to avoid the parameter explosion of next-generation reservoir computing (truncated Volterra series), reporting better accuracy and computational efficiency than conventional echo state networks on chaotic time-series prediction.
ax-2505.17740.title: A tensor network approach for chaotic time series prediction

ax-2505.18413.authors: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Xiangyu Chen, Jing Liu, Ye Wang, Pu (Perry) Wang, Matthew Brand
ax-2505.18413.edge: a Tucker (HOSVD) decomposition of attention weights rather than a tensor-network chain
ax-2505.18413.summary: Turns large language and multimodal models into a reduced-dimension latent structure by extending local activation-aware decomposition to a global, attention-aware joint Tucker (HOSVD) decomposition of the attention weights; reports better accuracy than existing compression methods at equal latent dimension, including on multimodal reasoning benchmarks.
ax-2505.18413.title: LatentLLM: Attention-Aware Joint Tensor Compression

ax-2505.20132.authors: Safa Hamreras, Sukhbinder Singh, Román Orús
ax-2505.20132.summary: Position paper arguing that tensorized neural networks, whose dense weights are replaced by tensor-network decompositions, are underused for compression and interpretability, highlighting their scaling properties and the potential of bond indices to track how features evolve across layers, and listing research directions to remove adoption barriers.
ax-2505.20132.title: Tensorization is a powerful but underexplored tool for compression and interpretability of neural networks

ax-2506.00102.authors: Ema Puljak, Maurizio Pierini, Artur Garcia-Saez
ax-2506.00102.summary: A parametrised MPS with an isometric feature map operates on an autoencoder's latent space of simulated LHC events and is claimed to outperform established quantum methods at identifying new phenomena.
ax-2506.00102.title: Tensor Network for Anomaly Detection in the Latent Space of Proton Collision Events at the LHC

ax-2506.09105.authors: Javier Lopez-Piqueres, Pranav Deshpande, Archan Ray, Mattia J. Villani, Marco Pistoia, Niraj Kumar
ax-2506.09105.summary: One shared tensor-train indexed by layer, matrix type (and optionally head or task) adapts all transformer submodules, with a DMRG-inspired rank-adaptive optimiser; it uses up to about 30x fewer parameters than LoRA with under 1% average accuracy drop (Llama-2-7B commonsense: 69.2 vs 70.0 average).
ax-2506.09105.title: MetaTT: A Global Tensor-Train Adapter for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

ax-2506.13514.authors: Mingxue Xu, Yao Lei Xu, Danilo P. Mandic
ax-2506.13514.summary: Training-free tensor-train compression of each pretrained token embedding into a short matrix product state for sub-billion-parameter GPT-2/Cerebras-GPT and OPT models, giving about 2.0x embedding-layer compression with comparable task performance and roughly half the energy per query on a Raspberry Pi.
ax-2506.13514.title: TensorSLM: Energy-efficient Embedding Compression of Sub-billion Parameter Language Models on Low-end Devices

ax-2506.16456.authors: Jun Qi, Chen-Yu Liu, Sabato Marco Siniscalchi, Chao-Han Huck Yang, Min-Hsiu Hsieh
ax-2506.16456.summary: TensorGuide generates the two correlated LoRA matrices from a single unified tensor-train driven by controlled Gaussian noise (with a neural tangent kernel analysis), and reportedly beats standard LoRA and TT-LoRA in accuracy with fewer parameters on quantum-dot classification and GPT-2 fine-tuning (no numbers seen).
ax-2506.16456.title: Joint Tensor-Train Parameterization for Efficient and Expressive Low-Rank Adaptation

ax-2507.08836.authors: Damien Fovet, Shashank Chamoli, Sarah Oury, Srishti Singhal

links.label: Science News — A quantum trick helps trim bloated AI models (Dec 2025)

ax-2507.08836.splashWhy: Its finding — the CompactifAI-compressed Llama 3.1 8B used about 30–40% less energy than the original, depending on response length — was reported by Science News ('A quantum trick helps trim bloated AI models', Emily Conover, 16 Dec 2025).
ax-2507.08836.summary: Independent Sopra Steria evaluation of a CompactifAI-compressed Llama 3.1 8B (CompactifAI uses tensor networks alongside other techniques): total energy about 30% lower at 200 tokens and 39% lower at 1000 tokens, about 18% faster at 1000 tokens, with Ragas accuracy scores comparable to the full model.
ax-2507.08836.title: Accuracy and Consumption analysis from a compressed model by CompactifAI from Multiverse Computing

ax-2507.11136.summary: Places sparsity-inducing hierarchical priors on tensor-network factors so the model infers tensor rank and the most relevant features automatically, trained with a mean-field variational Bayesian ALS that has the same computational complexity as its deterministic counterpart.
ax-2507.11136.title: Interpretable Bayesian Tensor Network Kernel Machines with Automatic Rank and Feature Selection

ax-2507.23346.summary: Tracks entanglement entropy, magnetisation, transfer entropy and O-information in MPS classifiers on Fashion-MNIST and hyperspectral satellite imagery, finding that grokking on Fashion-MNIST coincides with a sharp entanglement transition and a peak in redundant information while the overfitted hyperspectral model stays synergistic.
ax-2507.23346.title: Transfer entropy and O-information to detect grokking in tensor network multi-class classification problems

ax-2508.06251.summary: Uses MPS to generate privacy-preserving tabular synthetic data with differential privacy (noise injection, gradient clipping, Renyi DP accounting), reporting that it outperforms CTGAN, VAE and PrivBayes, especially under strict privacy constraints.
ax-2508.06251.title: Synthetic Data Generation and Differential Privacy using Tensor Networks' Matrix Product States (MPS)

ax-2509.03234.authors: Yuxuan Gu, Wuyang Zhou, Giorgos Iacovides, Danilo Mandic
ax-2509.03234.edge: Tucker-like random tensor network rather than a TN of linked cores
ax-2509.03234.summary: Folds the weight update into an order-N tensor expressed as a Tucker-like random tensor network (borderline TN) whose large factors are frozen and shared across layers while only small per-layer scaling vectors are trained; on Llama-3-8B commonsense it averages 85.31% with 0.0033% trainable parameters versus 82.88% for LoRA at 0.17%.
ax-2509.03234.title: TeRA: Vector-based Random Tensor Network for High-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

ax-2509.06653.authors: Borja Aizpurua, Sukhbinder Singh, Román Orús
ax-2509.06653.summary: Compresses a linear layer of a pretrained image classifier into an MPO and disentangles it, running the disentangling circuits on a quantum computer and the rest classically, with an explicit variational and an implicit gradient-descent disentangling algorithm demonstrated as proof of concept on MNIST and CIFAR-10.
ax-2509.06653.title: Classical Neural Networks on Quantum Devices via Tensor Network Disentanglers: A Case Study in Image Classification

ax-2509.08071.authors: Engin Danis, Duc Truong, Kim Ø. Rasmussen, Boian S. Alexandrov
ax-2509.08071.edge: scientific computing rather than deep learning
ax-2509.08071.summary: Three nonintrusive operator-inference methods (full-order, quantized and reduced-order) built on tensor-train representations of snapshot data, tested on computational fluid dynamics problems against standard reduced-order operator inference.
ax-2509.08071.title: Tensor-Train Operator Inference

ax-2509.21287.authors: Kin Ian Lo, Hala Hawashin, Mina Abbaszadeh, Tilen Limback-Stokin, Hadi Wazni, Mehrnoosh Sadrzadeh
ax-2509.21287.summary: Replaces CLIP's text tower with a tensor-network encoder whose contractions follow CCG grammatical derivations, cutting parameters from tens of millions to under one million while raising SVO-Probes verb accuracy from 77.6% to 82.4% and reaching 93.7% on the new SVO-Swap benchmark.
ax-2509.21287.title: DisCoCLIP: A Distributional Compositional Tensor Network Encoder for Vision-Language Understanding

ax-2510.13386.authors: Yani Feng, Michael K. Ng, Kejun Tang, Zhiwen Zhang
ax-2510.13386.summary: FTTNN represents PDE solutions on non-uniform grids and irregular domains by approximating tensor-train core functions with neural networks and adding a functional TT-rank term to a physics-informed loss, with Gauss quadrature reducing high-dimensional integrals, and reports better performance than PINNs.
ax-2510.13386.title: Functional tensor train neural network for solving high-dimensional PDEs

ax-2510.16820.edge: tensor-structured autoencoders; the tensor-network link is indirect
ax-2510.16820.summary: Uses bilinear autoencoders to decompose network representations into input-independent quadratic polynomials (third-order encoder tensor analysed with tensor diagrams) with extensions for importance ordering, clustering and sparsity, reporting over 99% cross-seed similarity for the vanilla variant on Qwen3-0.6B-Base layer 18 (tensor-network link is indirect, so borderline for strict scope).
ax-2510.16820.title: Finding Manifolds With Bilinear Autoencoders

ax-2510.21599.authors: Reda Marzouk, Shahaf Bassan, Guy Katz
ax-2510.21599.summary: Gives a general framework for provably exact SHAP computation on arbitrary tensor-network structures, with poly-logarithmic parallel time for tensor trains (covering decision trees, tree ensembles, linear models and linear RNNs) and a result that SHAP for binarized neural networks is tractable at fixed width but hard even at constant depth.
ax-2510.21599.title: SHAP Meets Tensor Networks: Provably Tractable Explanations with Parallelism
ax-2510.21599.venue: NeurIPS 2025 (venue as cited in later papers)

ax-2510.21844.summary: Compresses LLMs with infinite PEPS and tensor renormalization group contraction to capture multi-directional correlations across layers; on LLaMA-2 7B it reports up to 93% memory and 70% parameter reduction, about 50% faster training and 25% faster inference with 2-3% accuracy loss (single-author preprint).
ax-2510.21844.title: KARIPAP: Quantum-Inspired Tensor Network Compression of Large Language Models Using Infinite Projected Entangled Pair States and Tensor Renormalization Group

ax-2510.22138.authors: Farzaneh Heidari, Chao Li, Guillaume Rabusseau
ax-2510.22138.summary: TN-SHAP replaces exponential coalition enumeration with a tensor-network surrogate of a predictor's local behaviour, computing order-1 and order-2 Shapley interactions in O(n poly(chi) + n^2), matching enumeration on the surrogate and running 25-1000x faster than KernelSHAP-IQ at comparable accuracy on UCI datasets.
ax-2510.22138.title: Tractable Shapley Values and Interactions via Tensor Networks

ax-2510.26543.authors: Miranda Anna Christ, Adrian Csiszarik, Gergely Becso, Daniel Varga
ax-2510.26543.edge: tensor networks used as an analysis tool on LLM operators
ax-2510.26543.splashWhy: Accepted as a NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight (listed as 'Spotlight Poster' on neurips.cc; also announced by the Renyi Institute at ai.renyi.hu/announcements/tensor-networks/). Tensor networks serve as the compression and analysis tool (order-3 TNs), so scope is borderline.
ax-2510.26543.summary: Shows that a whole collection of linear relation-decoding operators in LLMs can be compressed with simple order-3 tensor networks at little accuracy cost, and uses this redundancy to argue the operators extract coarse semantic properties rather than relation-specific facts.
ax-2510.26543.title: The Structure of Relation Decoding Linear Operators in Large Language Models

ax-2511.01845.edge: tensor networks are one of two classical surrogate tools
ax-2511.01845.summary: Treats quantum circuit Born machines as quantum Fourier models and quantifies, using tensor-network and Pauli-propagation classical surrogates, when classically trained parameters can be deployed on quantum hardware, with analytic results for IQP and Haldane-chain ansatze (tensor networks are one of two surrogate tools, so borderline).
ax-2511.01845.title: The Born Ultimatum: Conditions for Classical Surrogation of Quantum Generative Models with Correlators

ax-2511.03765.authors: Hyunseok Kwak, Kyeongwon Lee, Jae-Jin Lee, Woojoo Lee
ax-2511.03765.summary: Applies TT-SVD to pretrained CNN convolution layers and trains only the output-side TT core (merged back into dense kernels), cutting trainable parameters by up to two orders of magnitude; reaches within 4.7% of full fine-tuning while updating at most 1.49% of parameters and converges 1.4-3.8x faster on a Jetson Orin Nano.
ax-2511.03765.title: LoRA-Edge: Tensor-Train-Assisted LoRA for Practical CNN Fine-Tuning on Edge Devices

ax-2512.02532.summary: A Bayesian tensor-train kernel machine that applies a Laplace approximation to one selected TT core and variational inference for precision hyperparameters, replacing cross-validation with training up to 65x faster, demonstrated on an inverse-dynamics problem.
ax-2512.02532.title: Laplace Approximation For Tensor Train Kernel Machines In System Identification

ax-2512.05338.summary: Reformulates the Shapley Taylor Interaction Index as a multilinear weight tensor with an exact tensor-train representation, gives a parallel NC^2 algorithm for tensor-train-structured value functions, and proves the same computation is #P-hard for general tensor-network representations.
ax-2512.05338.title: Interaction Tensor SHAP

ax-2512.24663.authors: Maolin Wang, Bowen Yu, Sheng Zhang, Linjie Mi, Wanyu Wang, Yiqi Wang, Pengyue Jia, Xuetao Wei, Zenglin Xu, Ruocheng Guo, Xiangyu Zhao
ax-2512.24663.edge: tensor-network structure search for data tensors (light fields, video), not for neural networks
ax-2512.24663.summary: Searches tensor-network topologies and ranks with renormalization-group flows: learnable edge gates expand and compress the network from coarse to fine scales. On light-field data, synthetic high-order tensors and video completion it reports state-of-the-art compression with a search several to hundreds of times faster than existing methods.
ax-2512.24663.title: Renormalization Group Guided Tensor Network Structure Search

ax-2601.06788.authors: Min Chen, Zihan Wang, Canyu Chen, Zeguan Wu, Manling Li, Junyu Liu
ax-2601.06788.summary: Views LoRA updates as low-dimensional matrix product states and measures entanglement entropy of LoRA parameters and attention matrices in LLaMA 1B and 8B, reporting volume-law internal and area-law external entanglement, with an MPS-adaptation PEFT behaving similarly.
ax-2601.06788.title: Artificial Entanglement in the Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models

ax-2601.10045.authors: Pradip Kunwar, Minh Vu, Maanak Gupta, Manish Bhattarai
ax-2601.10045.summary: Proposes the tensor-train LoRA adapter TTLoRA and TTLoRA-DP, which extends ghost clipping to TT cores for exact per-example gradient norms under DP-SGD; fine-tuning GPT-2 on Enron and Penn Treebank, it improves the privacy-utility trade-off over LoRA-DP with on average 7.6x fewer parameters and lower membership leakage.
ax-2601.10045.title: Privacy Enhanced PEFT: Tensor Train Decomposition Improves Privacy Utility Tradeoffs under DP-SGD

ax-2601.10801.summary: Evaluates MPS and tree tensor networks for HL-LHC Level-1 trigger jet tagging on low-level constituent features, reaching performance competitive with state-of-the-art deep classifiers, with post-training quantisation and FPGA synthesis estimates showing sub-microsecond latency.
ax-2601.10801.title: Towards Tensor Network Models for Low-Latency Jet Tagging on FPGAs

ax-2601.15442.authors: Alex Goessmann, Janina Schütte, Maximilian Fröhlich, Martin Eigel
ax-2601.15442.summary: Formalises neuro-symbolic AI with tensor networks, representing logical formulas and probability distributions as structured tensor decompositions and recasting reasoning as contraction-based message passing, which enables trainable Hybrid Logic Networks (library tnreason).
ax-2601.15442.title: A tensor network formalism for neuro-symbolic AI

ax-2602.01613.summary: A compression pipeline (not a general library) in which a small CNN predicts layer sensitivity, low-sensitivity regions are compressed with a mix of Tucker, tensor-train and tensor-ring decompositions, followed by healing fine-tuning and custom Triton/CUDA kernels, cutting Qwen3-32B peak VRAM at 8k context from 64 to 40 GiB and raising single-request throughput from 40 to 50 tokens/s (75 with speculative decoding).
ax-2602.01613.title: A Practical Tensor-Network Compression Pipeline for Production-Scale Large Language Models

ax-2602.04676.edge: quantum simulation (VQE) rather than machine learning
ax-2602.04676.summary: Uses differentiable 2D tensor networks to pre-optimise parameterised circuits for transverse-field Ising ground states (high energy accuracy, including beyond 1D), argues such warm starts give gradients that do not shrink exponentially with system size, and estimates the classical cost of evaluating them to locate where quantum hardware scales better.
ax-2602.04676.title: Pre-optimization of quantum circuits, barren plateaus and classical simulability: tensor networks to unlock the variational quantum eigensolver

ax-2602.06110.authors: José Ramón Pareja Monturiol, Juliette Sinnott, Roger G. Melko, Mohammad Kohandel
ax-2602.06110.summary: Shows parameter-recovery and cohort membership-inference attacks on a public immunotherapy-response logistic regression (a 35-patient cohort is reliably identified within training sets of hundreds to thousands) and defends by converting discretised models to tensor trains, which obscures parameters, keeps accuracy, gives black-box protection comparable to practical differential-privacy baselines, and allows marginal and conditional computations for interpretability.
ax-2602.06110.title: Private and interpretable clinical prediction with quantum-inspired tensor train models

ax-2602.16266.authors: Guang Lin, Toshihisa Tanaka, Qibin Zhao
ax-2602.16266.summary: TNQE decomposes each input into a tensor network whose cores are learnable block unitaries compiled into encoding circuits, reaching depths as low as 0.04x that of amplitude encoding, scaling to 256x256 images and showing feasibility on real quantum hardware.
ax-2602.16266.title: Structured Unitary Tensor Network Representations for Circuit-Efficient Quantum Data Encoding

ax-2603.11131.summary: A single-author QCNN with localised cost functions and a hardware-efficient tensor-network initialisation that self-reports 98.7% MNIST accuracy versus 52.32% for an unmitigated QCNN and O(log N) fewer trainable parameters than comparable classical CNNs.
ax-2603.11131.title: Beyond Barren Plateaus: A Scalable Quantum Convolutional Architecture for High-Fidelity Image Classification

ax-2603.12026.authors: Haotong Duan, Zhongming Chen, Ngai Wong
ax-2603.12026.summary: Trains unitary matrix product states as generative models with Riemannian optimisation and a space-decoupling algorithm, reporting fast adaptation, stable updates and strong performance on Bars-and-Stripes and EMNIST (no numbers in the abstract).
ax-2603.12026.title: Efficient Generative Modeling with Unitary Matrix Product States Using Riemannian Optimization

ax-2603.26604.authors: Sagar Addepalli, Prajita Bhattarai, Abhilasha Dave, Julia Gonski
ax-2603.26604.summary: Introduces a spaced matrix product operator (and a cascaded variant) for anomaly detection with FPGA-compatible resource use and trigger-level latency.
ax-2603.26604.title: Hardware-Aware Tensor Networks for Real-Time Quantum-Inspired Anomaly Detection at Particle Colliders

ax-2603.28534.authors: Younes Javanmard, Tanmoy Pandit, Masoud Mardani
ax-2603.28534.summary: Replaces every linear layer of a roughly 1M-parameter GPT-2-style character model with an MPO (TT-SVD or random initialisation); at bond dimension 16 it uses 191,872 versus 1,020,224 parameters while keeping 97.7% of baseline token accuracy (51.6% vs 52.8%), and reaches up to 13x compression per block at bond dimension 4.
ax-2603.28534.title: Compressing Transformer Language Models via Matrix Product Operator Decomposition: A Case Study on PicoGPT

ax-2604.01616.authors: Hiroshi Yamauchi, Anders Peter Kragh Dalskov, Hideaki Kawaguchi, Rodney Van Meter
ax-2604.01616.summary: A federated medical image classification pipeline in which client-side MPS, TTN and MERA frontends compress inputs into latent features, MPC-secured aggregation protects them and a quantum refinement step follows; on PneumoniaMNIST the TTN frontend with the quantum step gives the most balanced profile and MPC cost is driven by the latent dimension.
ax-2604.01616.title: Quantum-Enhanced Processing with Tensor-Network Frontends for Privacy-Aware Federated Medical Diagnosis

ax-2604.09263.authors: Nikolas Klug, Michael Ulbrich, André Uschmajew, Marius Willner
ax-2604.09263.summary: Derives a natural Riemannian gradient for training low-rank functional tree tensor networks with arbitrary losses (beyond least-squares ALS), with a hierarchy of cheap approximations, reporting considerably improved convergence on classification datasets.
ax-2604.09263.title: Natural Riemannian gradient for learning functional tensor networks

ax-2604.14287.authors: Guillermo Valverde, Igor García-Olaizola, Giannicola Scarpa, Alejandro Pozas-Kerstjens
ax-2604.14287.summary: Critical review of how tensor networks are used in machine learning, both as standalone models and as decompositions of neural-network components, covering compression, explainability and privacy, deep-learning integration, supervised and unsupervised learning, quantum ML and software, and assessing benefits and open challenges.
ax-2604.14287.title: Quantum-inspired tensor networks in machine learning models

ax-2604.20180.authors: Ryo Watanabe, Dries Sels, Joseph Tindall
ax-2604.20180.edge: quantum optimisation (QAOA) rather than machine learning
ax-2604.20180.summary: Uses a 2D tensor-network ansatz to simulate QAOA on Ising spin glasses on heavy-hex and square lattices, finding that parameters trained on small instances transfer to systems about ten times larger but help only up to intermediate depth, while training with tensor-network simulations on larger systems avoids local minima and gives lower-energy samples.
ax-2604.20180.title: Tensor network surrogate models for variational quantum computation

ax-2604.25631.summary: Builds classical tensor-train surrogates of trained quantum ML models on local input patches by combining Taylor expansion with a TT fit and splits the error into Taylor truncation, TT-rank and statistical terms, with parameter count N(p+1)chi^2 that is polynomial in the input dimension N versus (p+1)^N naively, though worst-case constants stay exponential.
ax-2604.25631.title: Local tensor-train surrogates for quantum learning models

ax-2604.26673.summary: LA-TNKM applies a linearised Laplace approximation to tensor-network kernel machines for uncertainty quantification, reportedly matching or beating Gaussian processes and Bayesian neural networks on UCI regression benchmarks.
ax-2604.26673.title: Laplace Approximation for Bayesian Tensor Network Kernel Machines

ax-2605.15183.authors: ML Nissen Gonzalez, Melwina Albuquerque, Laurence Wroe, Jacob Meyer Cohen, Logan Riggs Smith, Thomas Dooms
ax-2605.15183.edge: weight-based analysis of tensor-based (bilinear) models, not tensor networks proper
ax-2605.15183.summary: Introduces tensor similarity, a weight-based metric for tensor-based (e.g. bilinear) models that is invariant to weight-space symmetries, captures global functional equivalence and handles cross-layer mechanisms recursively; it tracks grokking and backdoor insertion more faithfully than existing similarity metrics.
ax-2605.15183.title: When Are Two Networks the Same? Tensor Similarity for Mechanistic Interpretability

ax-2605.17895.authors: Kun Zhang, Lei Ding, Sheng-Chen Bai, Jing Sun, An-Qi Jing, Min Tang, Shi-Ju Ran
ax-2605.17895.summary: Represents each class by a generative MPS prototype living in the same Hilbert space as quantum-encoded samples so classification and clustering use geometric measures on quantum states, reporting gains over classical prototype methods and competitiveness with black-box neural networks on Fashion-MNIST and an ECG dataset.
ax-2605.17895.title: Geometric Prototype Learning in Quantum Hilbert Space with Matrix Product States

ax-2605.19842.authors: Safa Hamreras, Sukhbinder Singh, Román Orús
ax-2605.19842.summary: Tensorizes a pretrained network slice by slice (a layer, block or short group of layers), fitting each tensorized slice to reproduce the original intermediate features instead of using global fine-tuning; reported to give significant gains over global tensorization on ResNet-34 with near-lossless moderate compression and to scale to GPT-2 XL (no numeric results seen).
ax-2605.19842.title: Fast Tensorization of Neural Networks via Slice-wise Feature Distillation

ax-2605.25344.authors: Ying Lu, Peng-Fei Zhou, Qi-Xuan Fang, Pan Zhang, Shi-Ju Ran, Gang Su

links.label: Full text (HTML v1, indexed under the earlier title "A general tensor-structured compression scheme for efficient large language models")

ax-2605.25344.summary: Introduces Tensor Mixture (MixT), which replaces a dense linear map in a Transformer block by a natively executable sum of overlapping local tensor operators, borrowing the local-term decomposition of a quantum Hamiltonian instead of imposing a matrix-rank constraint. On Qwen3-8B and LLaMA2-7B it reports a broad regime in which accuracy is recoverable, then an abrupt model-specific boundary beyond which accuracy and output-distribution statistics reorganise together, while cutting parameters, arithmetic, storage and memory.
ax-2605.25344.title: A Hamiltonian-Inspired Local-Operator Ansatz for Slimming Large Language Models

ax-2606.00130.summary: Generates large weight tensors from hierarchies of small trained cores with nonlinearities (tree tensor networks, augmented TTNs with boundary disentanglers, MERA), reporting per-layer compression of roughly 2,000x to 77,000x on AlexNet and VGG-16 layers with accuracy often matching the dense baseline.
ax-2606.00130.title: Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs) for Exponential Compression of Deep Neural Networks

ax-2606.01540.summary: Learns from few oracle queries a tensor-network surrogate whose topology mirrors the input graph, yielding deterministic first- and higher-order Shapley indices that closely match exact values on small molecular graphs and scale to larger graphs where sampling methods become infeasible.
ax-2606.01540.title: TN-SHAP-G: Graph-Structured Tensor Network Surrogates for Shapley Values and Interactions

ax-2606.03465.authors: Artur Zagitov, Alexander Miasnikov, Maxim Krutikov, Vladimir Aletov, Gleb Molodtsov, Nail Bashirov, Artem Tsedenov, Aleksandr Beznosikov
ax-2606.03465.summary: Large-scale negative-result study of Tucker and tensor-train post-training compression on GPT-J 6B, LLaMA 2 7B and MoE models (Qwen3-30B-A3B, GPT-OSS-20B), concluding that tensor decompositions are generally dominated by matrix methods and quantization (at about 17% bits saved, Tucker on attention plus LASER on FFN reaches perplexity about 19 while TT-based combinations exceed 28).
ax-2606.03465.title: Rethinking the Role of Tensor Decompositions in Post-Training LLM Compression

ax-2606.08565.authors: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Jing Liu, Ye Wang
ax-2606.08565.summary: Adaptive tensorization that reorders (sorts) tensor indices to expose low-rank structure before factorising; on LLM weight and KV-cache compression it reconstructs the original tensors more accurately than baseline tensorizations.
ax-2606.08565.title: EinSort: Sorting is All We Need for Tensorizing LLM

ax-2606.09988.authors: Hao-Kai Zhang, Chenghong Zhu, Shuo Liu, Shi-Xin Zhang, Tao Xiang
ax-2606.09988.edge: MPS energy landscapes in physics; relevant to trainability
ax-2606.09988.summary: Proves that MPS energy landscapes have no poor local minima in the same setting where brickwork circuits are reported to have many, because gauge freedom acts as local overparametrisation that concentrates local minima near the global minimum, accounting for DMRG-style trainability.
ax-2606.09988.title: Absence of poor local minima in matrix product states

ax-2606.14613.summary: Establishes a Riemannian fundamental theorem for tensor-network manifolds, describing how gauge freedom interacts with the Riemannian structure via group actions and Riemannian submersions, as a basis for optimisation on TN manifolds.
ax-2606.14613.title: Tensor network manifolds and Riemannian fundamental theorem for tensor networks

ax-2607.00365.edge: a broad AI–quantum review with one section on tensor networks
ax-2607.00365.summary: Broad two-way review of AI for quantum information and quantum information for AI whose table of contents includes a dedicated section (IV.E, about pages 34-40) on tensor-network methods for machine learning, so only partly on TN scope.
ax-2607.00365.title: When AI meets quantum information: A comprehensive review

ax-2607.06841.authors: Robert Gruhlke, Julius Berner, David Sommer, Lorenz Richter
ax-2607.06841.summary: Solves the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation governing diffusion-based samplers with a functional tensor-train representation and a BSDE-derived backward iteration, offered as a faster, more robust and accurate sampler for challenging high-dimensional targets than PINN or trajectory-based solvers.
ax-2607.06841.title: Tensor Train Diffusion: Leveraging Low-Rank Structures for High-Dimensional Score-Based Sampling

ax-2607.17390.authors: Duc Thien Nguyen, Konstantinos Slavakis, Eleftherios Kofidis, Dimitris Pados
ax-2607.17390.summary: KReTTaH does training-data-free multi-way imputation as kernel regression with fixed-rank tensor-train coefficients optimised on a Riemannian product manifold with Hadamard overparameterisation, reportedly beating tensor, Bayesian and neural baselines on fMRI imputation and dynamic-graph edge-flow recovery.
ax-2607.17390.title: Kernel Regression with Tensor Trains and Hadamard Overparameterization

ax-2607.19503.summary: MPS classifier for wildfire susceptibility in the Gargano region (AlphaEarth embeddings) with an interpretable quantum mask, a reported grokking transition in the binary case, and reduced-density-matrix mixedness diagnostics showing non-adjacent classes are more separable than neighbouring ones.
ax-2607.19503.title: Tensor Network Machine Learning for Wildfire Susceptibility Mapping: from Grokking Dynamics to Quantum Mixedness of Class Representations

ax-2608.07043.summary: tnkm, an open-source JAX library for tensor-network kernel machines that unifies feature maps, TN architectures and optimisers (ALS and gradient-based), reporting competitive accuracy with compact parameterisations on nonlinear system-identification benchmarks.
ax-2608.07043.title: Tensor Network Kernel Machines: A JAX Framework for Machine Learning and Nonlinear System Identification

ax-2608.18901.authors: Gustav J. L. Jäger, Martin B. Plenio, Hans-Martin Rieser
ax-2608.18901.summary: Adds a global normalisation condition so that an MPS classifier represents a valid quantum state, then compares gradient-descent training of the local tensors with a DMRG-style local update.
ax-2608.18901.title: Quantum Tensor Network Learning with DMRG

ax-2608.21368.summary: Trains an MPS classifier on gray-matter MRI features (controls vs schizophrenia and vs bipolar disorder) and turns its quantum connected correlations into a weighted feature graph whose node centralities vary less across resamplings than Shapley values.
ax-2608.21368.title: A Tensor Network Framework for Interpretable Graph Analysis of Brain Networks

ax-2608.30505.authors: Matvei Tarasov, Salman Ahmadi-Asl, Andre L. F. de Almeida, Andrzej Cichocki
ax-2608.30505.summary: Survey organising tensor decompositions and tensor networks for LLMs along a seven-stage lifecycle (tokenisation to interpretability) and by Transformer component, with unified notation, cross-method comparison and a new metric rho_gap for the gap between theoretical memory savings and measured system-level speedup.
ax-2608.30505.title: Tensor Methods for Language Models: From Token Representation to Training, Adaptation, Inference, Compression, and Interpretability

ax-2609.00870.authors: Marius Willner, Maximilian Scharf, André Uschmajew, Timo Felser, Marco Trenti
ax-2609.00870.summary: Derives adaptive, learning-rate-free stochastic Riemannian optimisers for tree tensor networks on parameter and quotient manifolds, matching unconstrained-optimisation accuracy in a hybrid CNN-TTN on Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10 and Imagenette while allowing numerically stable downstream compression.
ax-2609.00870.title: Stochastic Optimization of Tree Tensor Networks

ax-2609.04165.authors: Matthias C. Caro, Natalie McHugh, Sergii Strelchuk
ax-2609.04165.edge: learning theory of quantum states rather than neural networks
ax-2609.04165.summary: Shows cutwidth and tree-cutwidth bound the bond-dimension overhead of converting a TN state to MPS or TTN and gives graph-dependent sample and computational complexity for realisable and agnostic learning, extending the Cramer et al. MPS learner to TTNs and arbitrary known graphs.
ax-2609.04165.title: Parameterised graph theory for tensor networks: entanglement rerouting, structural simplification, and agnostic tomography

ax-2609.07184.summary: Introduces Computation-Activation Networks (CompActNets), a TN architecture that represents any discrete maximum-entropy distribution (exponential families and their boundary closures via polytope faces), using TN ranks as complexity measures.
ax-2609.07184.title: Tensor network representations of discrete maximum entropy distributions via mean polytopes

ax-2609.25058.authors: Ashfak Yeafi, Mehedi Hasan, Md Khairul Islam
ax-2609.25058.summary: Replaces DoRA's dense low-rank directional factors with a connected tensor-train chain; on LLaMA-7B across seven commonsense benchmarks (TT rank 16) it averages 72.30% versus 69.88% for LoRA and 69.39% for DoRA with 5.35M versus 56.10M and 56.98M trainable parameters (90.62% fewer than DoRA).
ax-2609.25058.title: ChainDoRA: Tensor-Train Factorized Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning

ax-2609.30148.authors: Constantin Cedillo Vayson de Pradenne, Jordan Cotler
ax-2609.30148.edge: learning theory of quantum states rather than neural networks
ax-2609.30148.summary: Gives proper agnostic learning algorithms for MPS and bounded-degree tree tensor networks that output a bond-dimension-constrained pure state within epsilon of the best in class, with copy complexity and runtime polynomial in system size, local dimension, bond dimension and 1/epsilon.
ax-2609.30148.title: Proper Agnostic Learning of Matrix Product States and Tree Tensor Networks

ax-2610.06080.authors: Shi-Tuan Wang, Zidu Liu, Li-Wei Yu
ax-2610.06080.summary: Moment-based analysis shows MPS models converge to Gaussian processes at large bond dimension (with explicit finite-size bounds on higher moments) but that Gaussian universality breaks down at large physical dimension for global observables.
ax-2610.06080.title: Gaussian Universality and Its Breakdown in Tensor-Network Machine Learning

ax-2610.10085.authors: Alessandro Beatini, Marco Maronese, Emanuele Rodolà
ax-2610.10085.summary: Activation-aware Weight Tensorization (AWT) is a training-free calibration wrapper that rescales each weight matrix by a diagonal activation-derived factor before an unchanged Tensor Train or Tree Tensor Network solver, then deploys with only an input-side elementwise rescaling. It reports consistent gains over vanilla tensorization at 2-6x compression on Llama 3.1 8B, Ministral 8B and Qwen2.5 7B, including on HellaSwag and ARC-Challenge.
ax-2610.10085.title: Activation-Aware Weight Tensorization: A Calibration-Time Preconditioner for Tensor-Network LLM Compression

ax-2610.13694.authors: Amit S. Patel, Himanshu R. Patel, Bikash K. Behera, Pranav Mehta, Ghanshyam Tejani, Deepak Parashar
ax-2610.13694.edge: the tensor-network structure is the entanglement pattern of a quantum circuit rather than a classical TN model, so it sits on the QML side of the scope
ax-2610.13694.summary: Adds tensor-network-style nearest-neighbour entanglement to a recurrent quantum neural network that encodes features one at a time and carries quantum memory across steps, with QSMOTE for class imbalance. On the SPID fault-diagnosis dataset it lifts F1 from 0.3077 to 0.4516 and ROC-AUC from 0.4485 to 0.6970 over the RQNN baseline while cutting two-qubit gates per sample from 32 to 24, though the authors note the gain is not uniform across their four datasets.
ax-2610.13694.title: QTN-RQNN: Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network

pp-applying-quantum-tensor-networks-in-m.authors: Erico Souza Teixeira, Yara Rodrigues Inácio, Pamela Bezerra
pp-applying-quantum-tensor-networks-in-m.summary: Systematic review of 23 studies (2013-2024) on quantum tensor networks in quantum machine learning, reporting resource reductions via data compression, noise robustness and circuit optimisation, with speedups up to 10-million-fold in specific scenarios and accuracy up to 0.95 with fewer parameters and less training data.
pp-applying-quantum-tensor-networks-in-m.title: Applying Quantum Tensor Networks in Machine Learning: A Systematic Literature Review

pp-introduction-to-tensor-network-method.summary: Second edition of a graduate textbook adding newer tensor-network algorithms, tree tensor networks for high-dimensional systems and lattice gauge theory, and presenting in detail the implementation of tensor networks for machine learning.
pp-introduction-to-tensor-network-method.title: Introduction to Tensor Network Methods: From Many-Body Quantum Systems to Machine Learning (2nd edition)
pp-introduction-to-tensor-network-method.venue: Springer, Graduate Texts in Physics (eBook listed 16 May 2026, hardcover 13 July 2026)

pp-mtnl-a-unified-modeling-perspective-f.authors: Junhua Zeng, Yuning Qiu, Binghua Li, Chao Li, Qibin Zhao, Guoxu Zhou
pp-mtnl-a-unified-modeling-perspective-f.summary: Proposes mixed tensor network learning that fuses multiple TNs in a deep-network style, adds a flexible TN structure-search prior and a Bayesian uncertainty method, and evaluates on tensor recovery, parameter-efficient fine-tuning and tensor regression.
pp-mtnl-a-unified-modeling-perspective-f.title: MTNL: A Unified Modeling Perspective for Enhancing Tensor Network Learning

pp-surviving-resource-constraint-compres.authors: Mingxue Xu, Yao Lei Xu, Danilo P. Mandic
pp-surviving-resource-constraint-compres.summary: Compresses pretrained token embeddings of sub-billion-parameter LMs into matrix product states without retraining and studies which language abilities survive across GPT, OPT, Qwen and MiniCPM4-0.5B.
pp-surviving-resource-constraint-compres.title: Surviving Resource-constraint Compression: Capability Retention under Tensor-train Decomposition for Sub-billion Parameter Language Models

pp-tensor-compressed-and-fully-quantized.authors: Jinming Lu, Jiayi Tian, Yequan Zhao, Zheng Zhang, Hai Li
pp-tensor-compressed-and-fully-quantized.summary: Trains PINNs on edge devices with tensor-train layers, fully quantized MX-INT training and Stein's derivative estimator, plus a 7-nm accelerator, reporting accuracy comparable to or better than full-precision baselines on 2-D Poisson, 20-D HJB and 100-D Heat equations with 5.5x-83.5x speedups and 159.6x-2324.1x energy savings versus an autodiff GPU baseline.
pp-tensor-compressed-and-fully-quantized.title: Tensor-Compressed and Fully-Quantized Training of Neural PDE Solvers
pp-tensor-compressed-and-fully-quantized.venue: DATE 2026 proceedings (conference month not confirmed from the page; no arXiv version seen)

pp-tensor-network-based-feature-learning.summary: Feature Learning model learns the hyperparameters of polynomial/Fourier tensor-product features jointly with the parameters of a TN kernel machine by representing the features as a learnable CP decomposition trained with ALS, training 3-5x faster than a cross-validated model at comparable prediction quality.
pp-tensor-network-based-feature-learning.title: Tensor Network Based Feature Learning Model

pp-tensor-network-constrained-kernel-mac.summary: Proves that CP- and TT-constrained kernel machines with i.i.d. priors converge to the same Gaussian process as rank grows, with TT converging faster than CP at equal parameter count.
pp-tensor-network-constrained-kernel-mac.title: Tensor Network-Constrained Kernel Machines as Gaussian Processes

pp-tensor-network-from-the-perspective-o.authors: Junchi Yan, Yehui Tang, Xinyu Ye, Hao Xiong, Xiaoqiu Zhong, Yuhan Wang, Yuan Qi
pp-tensor-network-from-the-perspective-o.summary: Survey of tensor networks as numerical tools for Science4AI (matrix compression, information fusion, quantum-inspired algorithms) and AI4Science (neural quantum states), unifying tensorization across classical and modern architectures.
pp-tensor-network-from-the-perspective-o.title: Tensor Network: From the Perspective of AI4Science and Science4AI

pp-tensor-tree-learns-hidden-relational-.authors: Kenji Harada, Tsuyoshi Okubo, Naoki Kawashima
pp-tensor-tree-learns-hidden-relational-.summary: An adaptive tensor-tree Born machine optimises its tree structure by reducing mutual information across branches and, trained on about 10 years of S&P 500 patterns, learns branches that align with industry sectors.
pp-tensor-tree-learns-hidden-relational-.title: Tensor tree learns hidden relational structures in data to construct generative models

pp-trac-tensor-train-based-across-layer-.authors: Bangguo Ye, Yuanwei Zhang, Xiaoqun Zhang
pp-trac-tensor-train-based-across-layer-.summary: Represents each adaptation module as a short sequence of tensor-train cores, with some cores frozen or shared across layers and lightweight controllers adapting them per layer; evaluated on Qwen, LLaMA, GPT, BERT and ViT, reportedly matching or beating LoRA variants with substantially fewer trainable parameters and less storage (no numbers seen).
pp-trac-tensor-train-based-across-layer-.title: TRAC: Tensor-Train based Across-layer Compression for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
